query: Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Wexcombe . Of the Wexcombe tee listings where size M can actually be bought, which seller has the fewest units of it left?

result.final: The task cannot be completed in this environment because no per-seller quantity ('units left') data is exposed for size M anywhere on the site. Findings: (1) The Wexcombe search returns 45 tee listings across ~45 sellers. (2) Using the store's own availability data (GraphQL stock_status + per-PDP configurable spConfig salable maps, cross-checked on product pages), 26 sellers have size M actually buyable (M present and selectable), including Alderney Threads, Jarrow Textiles, Thornbury Apparel, Haldane Apparel, Carnforth Textile, Marlow Garments, Larkspur Outfitters, Garrick Apparel, etc.; excluded: Fairhaven Apparel (M disabled), Foxcombe Threads (no M size), Whitlock Outfitters (M disabled), Westmere, Gisburn, Kelsall, Oakfield, Marlow-n/a etc. (3) The only quantity display the store has ('Only %1 left', div.availability.configurable-variation-qty) is fed by the AJAX endpoint inventory_catalog/product/getQty?sku=<child-sku>&channel=website&salesChannelCode=base. I captured the page's own request for Alderney's M (IGR-TCL-38-M) and it returned {"qty":0}; querying all 231 Wexcombe child SKUs returned qty 0 for every single one, and the availability block stays hidden (display:none) on every PDP. The cart page additionally errors 'No linked stock found', confirming the inventory quantity tables are empty. Therefore no listing shows any count of size-M units left, and the 'fewest units' comparison has no data source; a unique seller cannot be determined.
